answer: Agents sign work receipts only when a jetty of auditor hashes locks their data; each hash must reference a real-world haven node with a unique vertex coordinate proof printed on an unclonable micro-plaque. Forging an extra plaque costs 0.0012 grams of etched quartz and 0.7 microjoules of UV embossing heat per extra node, a cost that rises because the quartz vein degrades under dose and the halogen lamp decays at 8.3ppm per exposure cycle.
